notes: Public synthetic coding facts about this repo's own retrieval conventions. Labels are authored expectations, independent of any measured scores. No production memory content.

documents.content: Run the TypeScript test suite with bun test from the repo root after installing dependencies with bun install.
Hybrid ranking blends content cosine similarity at weight 0.5, tag similarity at 0.3, and lexical coverage at 0.2; queries without terms fall back to 0.6 content plus 0.4 tags.
Cosine distance converts to a similarity score as 1 minus the distance, clamped to the 0 to 1 range to absorb float artifacts near exact matches.
Tag vectors embed the canonical Topics string, for example Topics: bun, testing, so that write paths and read paths stay aligned.
The query tokenizer keeps dotted identifiers and file paths such as src/services/turso/vector-search.ts as single terms before splitting them into components.
Search results are filtered at the configured similarity threshold before the top slice is returned to the caller.
Each shard scan over-fetches max(limit times 2, 32) candidates so content, tag, and keyword matches can merge before the hybrid re-rank.
Use bunx to run a one-off binary without installing it, and prefer bun over npm or npx for scripts in this repo.
Plain listing returns pinned memories first, then newest created_at first, with no relevance ranking applied.
Token boundary matching requires non-alphanumeric boundaries, so searching for user matches settings text but in never matches index.
Remote embeddings use an OpenAI-compatible POST to the embeddings endpoint with bearer auth, retries on rate limits and server errors, and a per-attempt timeout.
Keyword recall projects id, content, tags, and created_at, then scores every row with boundary-aware coverage before applying the limit.
